parameters.body:
={
  "ref_code": "{{ $json.refCode }}",
  "type": "{{ $json.intentType }}",
  "sender_email": "{{ $json.from }}",
  "source_lang": "de",
  "reply_lang": "{{ $json.replyLang }}",
  "payload": {{ JSON.stringify($json.extracted) }},
  "status": "pending"
}

={
  "slug": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.title_de ? ($json.pendingPayload.title_de.toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '').slice(0, 55) + '-' + $json.pendingRefCode) : ('event-' + $json.pendingRefCode) }}",
  "date": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.date }}",
  "time": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.time || '' }}",
  "location": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.location || 'Cafe Palestina' }}",
  "address": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.address || 'Geisselstrasse 3-5, 50823 Koeln' }}",
  "title_de": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.title_de }}",
  "title_en": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.title_en }}",
  "title_ar": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.title_ar }}",
  "description_de": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.description_de }}",
  "description_en": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.description_en }}",
  "description_ar": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.description_ar }}",
  "is_published": true
}

={
  "slug": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.title_de ? ($json.pendingPayload.title_de.toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '').slice(0, 55) + '-' + $json.pendingRefCode) : ('post-' + $json.pendingRefCode) }}",
  "title_de": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.title_de }}",
  "title_en": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.title_en }}",
  "title_ar": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.title_ar }}",
  "excerpt_de": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.excerpt_de || '' }}",
  "excerpt_en": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.excerpt_en || '' }}",
  "excerpt_ar": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.excerpt_ar || '' }}",
  "body_de": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.body_de }}",
  "body_en": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.body_en }}",
  "body_ar": "{{ $json.pendingPayload.body_ar }}",
  "status": "published",
  "published_at": "{{ new Date().toISOString() }}",
  "cover_image_url": null
}
